title: Geometry - Lesson 2 Assessment: Convert cm³ and L
description: Convert between cubic centimeters and liters and explain the operation used.

questions.question: Which equation is correct?
questions.explanation: The correct conversion is 1 L = 1000 cm³.

questions.question: Convert 8 L to cubic centimeters. Enter just the number.
Convert 9500 cm³ to liters. Enter just the number.
To convert cm³ to L, multiply by 1000.
questions.explanation: To convert cm³ to L, divide by 1000.

questions.question: A container holds 1.25 L. How many cubic centimeters is that?
Why is 100 not the correct conversion number between liters and cubic centimeters?
questions.correctAnswer: Because volume uses three dimensions. A 10 cm by 10 cm by 10 cm cube has 1000 cm³, not 100 cm³.
questions.explanation: 100 comes from 10 × 10, which is area. Volume needs 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000.

questions.question: Convert 0.4 L to cubic centimeters. Enter just the number.
Which conversion uses division by 1000?
questions.explanation: Converting cubic centimeters to liters uses division by 1000.

questions.question: A rectangular container has volume 3000 cm³. How many liters can it hold? Show the operation.
questions.explanation: Convert cm³ to L by dividing by 1000.

questions.question: A jug holds 6.5 L. How many cubic centimeters is that? Show the operation.
questions.explanation: Convert L to cm³ by multiplying by 1000.
